alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of Tablas de Daimiel at night, with the low rectangular hydraulic mill of Molemocho, a tiled stone hall and mill-race, and no windmill sails, seen from the boardwalk across the reed lagoons.
description: From the boardwalk at night, the Tablas de Daimiel spread out as moonlit lagoons and reed beds. Molino de Molemocho sits at the water as a long, low hydraulic mill of stone and rubble under a tiled roof, with its mill-race at water level. It is a water-mill, without La Mancha sail-arms.
